```{=html}

<div class="cv-card-page">

  <div class="cv-card-photo">

    <img
      src="assets/images/cv-portrait.jpg"
      alt="Swapnanil SenGupta"
      title="Less formal than the document next door."
    >

  </div>


  <div class="cv-card-content">

    <div class="cv-custom-title">
      My career, so far.
    </div>


    <div class="cv-live-preview">

      <iframe
        src="assets/files/cv.pdf#page=1&view=FitH&toolbar=0&navpanes=0"
        title="Preview of Swapnanil SenGupta's CV"
        tabindex="-1">
      </iframe>

      <a
        class="cv-preview-link"
        href="assets/files/cv.pdf"
        target="_blank"
        rel="noopener"
        aria-label="Open CV"
        title="View CV">
      </a>

      <div class="cv-preview-label">
        View full CV
      </div>

    </div>


    <a
      class="cv-card-download"
      href="assets/files/cv.pdf"
      download>

      <i class="bi bi-download"></i>
      Download CV

    </a>

  </div>

</div>
```
